taskDivision.Worker1:
Help build: Build a simple one-storey house near player Mauri67. The house should have a rectangular footprint of about 9x7 blocks, with walls 4 blocks tall and a simple gable or slightly sloped roof. Include windows on all sides, a main entrance on the side facing Mauri67, a basic interior (bed, crafting table, furnace, chests), and enough lighting to be mob-safe. Use common survival materials such as oak/spruce planks and logs with some stone/cobblestone accents. Do not damage any nearby player-built structures.

Your specific contribution:
Objective: Prepare terrain and build the western half of the floor and walls of the house.

Scope: ABSOLUTE COORDINATES - x:52 to 54, z:-87 to -81, y:-60 to -56.

Subtasks:
1. You are positioned at the western side of the planned 9x7 house footprint near player Mauri67. Begin building immediately within your region.
2. Within x:-4 to -2 and z:-3 to 3, lightly level terrain only as needed to support a flat floor at a single Y level; avoid digging more than 2 blocks below surface and prefer adding foundations (e.g., cobblestone) instead of heavy excavation.
3. Place a solid floor (e.g., oak_planks or stone) in your region at the chosen base Y level so it connects cleanly on x:-2 with Worker2’s and Worker3’s floors.
4. Build the western exterior wall along x:-4 from z:-3 to 3 and your portions of the north and south walls (z:-3 and z:3, for x:-4 to -2) up to 4 blocks tall using a consistent pattern (e.g., logs at corners/columns, planks or cobblestone infill).
5. Leave 1x2 window gaps in appropriate positions in your wall segments and frame them with matching materials so glass panes can be added or left open as desired.
6. Ensure wall tops are flat and at a uniform height of 4 blocks to support the roof that Worker3 will build.

Block Break Limit: Do not break more than about 70 blocks; avoid broad terrain flattening.

Assumptions: Assume Worker2 and Worker3 will continue the floor and walls eastward with matching height and style, and Worker3 will complete the roof and interior.

Constraints: Do NOT place or break blocks east of x:-2 except exactly on x:-2 for joins. Do not modify any clearly player-built nearby structures. Keep terrain changes limited to under and immediately around your section of the footprint.

CRITICAL: Use ABSOLUTE coordinates x:52 to 54, z:-87 to -81, y:-60 to -56. The boundary with Worker2 is at x:54.

Work together with nearby workers to create a cohesive structure. Position yourself strategically to connect your work with others.
